label: Telegram: Receive Message
description: Fires once per message sent to the bot, optionally filtered to one chat and a contained keyword. Activation starts from now; restarts never re-fire history.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Telegram bot access (wire a TelegramAccess node).

inputs.name: chatId
inputs.label: Chat id
inputs.description: Only fire on messages in this chat. Empty = every chat the bot is in.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.label: Contains
inputs.description: Only fire when the text contains this.
